countries.reasoning: China is the largest producer of calcium chloride based on USGS and industrial chemical production reports (2021-2023). Data is well documented but large private sector manufacturing introduces some minor uncertainty.
The US produces significant quantities of calcium chloride from natural brine sources and chemical manufacturing, with reliable data from USGS and industry associations.
India has substantial cement and chemical industries producing calcium chloride; data is solid but less centralized, hence moderate confidence.
Germany is a notable European producer with well-established chemical manufacturing; data is consistent but older data sources limit confidence to moderate.
Russia produces calcium chloride from chemical plants and mining byproducts; recent data is less comprehensive, so confidence is moderate to low.
